applicableAreas: Bottom right corner of site near overhead electric line
findings.comment: Four mitigation trees (marked 'M') are shown on the landscape plan in proximity to the overhead electric line on the south property boundary. However, the species of these trees cannot be determined because the landscape plan shows trees only by category symbol (M for Mitigation Tree) with no plant schedule legend or species identification, preventing verification of whether they are utility-compatible. Clarify species of all trees shown near overhead electric facilities.

applicableAreas: Bottom right corner of site near overhead electric line
findings.comment: Four mitigation trees are shown on the landscape plan near the overhead electric line on the south property boundary. The mature heights of these trees cannot be verified because: (1) species cannot be determined from the landscape plan symbols alone, and (2) the plant list shows only minimum planting sizes (8' to 16' HT at installation) not mature heights per ECM Appendix F. Clarify species and reference mature heights from ECM Appendix F to verify compliance with the 25-foot clearance for large trees (40+ feet mature height).

applicableAreas: Site-wide where overhead electric poles may be located
findings.comment: Overhead electric utility pole locations are not shown on the landscape plan (Sheet 31), preventing verification that trees are located more than 10 lateral feet from poles as required. The landscape plan shows overhead electric lines (OHE) but does not indicate pole locations. Show all utility pole locations on the landscape plan or provide a cross-reference to the electrical design plan (Sheet 21) to enable clearance verification.

applicableAreas: Site-wide where underground electric equipment may be located
findings.comment: Underground electric equipment locations are shown on the Electrical Design Plan (Sheet 21) but are not depicted on the Landscape Plan (Sheet 31), preventing verification that trees are located more than 5 lateral feet from underground equipment. Overlay the underground utility locations from Sheet 21 onto the landscape plan or provide a cross-reference to verify clearances.

applicableAreas: Site-wide where trees are proposed within 20 feet of underground equipment
findings.comment: Root barrier specifications for trees within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment are not shown on the landscape plan. Additionally, distances between trees and underground equipment cannot be verified because underground equipment locations from Sheet 21 are not depicted on the landscape plan. Identify any trees within 20 feet of underground equipment and specify root barrier requirements (minimum 4 feet deep, positioned 5 feet from equipment).

applicableAreas: Bottom right corner of site near overhead electric line; site-wide for all proposed trees
findings.comment: The landscape plan (Sheet 31) shows proposed trees using category symbols only (M for Mitigation Tree, SY for Street Yard, PL for Parking Lot, P for Parking Buffer), with no plant legend or schedule that identifies species. The four mitigation trees shown near the overhead electric line cannot be identified by species from the landscape plan. While Sheet 35 (Landscape Calculations) contains a plant list with species and sizes, there is no cross-reference from the landscape plan to this information and no legend on the landscape plan that associates symbols with species. Add a plant schedule or legend to the landscape plan that identifies the species of all trees, particularly those shown near overhead electric facilities.

Large trees (mature height 40+ feet per ECM Appendix F) are not differentiated or identified on the landscape plan. The plan shows all proposed trees using the same category symbols without any notation indicating mature height or size classification. This prevents verification of compliance with clearance requirements for large trees (40+ feet) near overhead electric facilities. The plant list on Sheet 35 shows only minimum planting specifications (e.g., 16' HT for container-grown trees at installation), not mature heights. Identify on the landscape plan which trees are large trees (40+ feet mature height) or provide mature height information per ECM Appendix F in the plant schedule.

applicableAreas: Bottom right corner of site near overhead electric line
findings.comment: Four mitigation trees are shown on the landscape plan in proximity to the overhead electric line where clearance restrictions apply. However, the species and mature heights of these trees cannot be determined from the landscape plan, so prohibited zones cannot be identified. No documentation of written approval from Austin Energy was found authorizing any variances to the standard clearance requirements. Once species and mature heights are clarified, verify whether any trees fall within prohibited clearance zones (less than 15 feet from distribution conductors, less than 25 feet for large trees from distribution, less than 10 feet from poles, or within transmission easements), and if so, provide documented written approval from Austin Energy.
